messages.layout: data {name}: disc (the 200 px record spinning), body (its 80 px label spinning on it), cover (over a still 400 px picture) or square (spokes). Replies with state.
messages.spin: data {rpm}: the spinning picture's spin, 0 to 60 turns a minute (0 stops it where it is). Replies with state.
messages.rotation: data {deg}: turns the spinning picture to deg, 0 to 359, spinning or not. Replies with state.
messages.scale: data {pct}: the spinning picture's scale, 10 to 400 percent (over 200 px on screen is an error while it spins). Replies with state.
messages.state: Change nothing. Replies {layout, rotation, spin, scale, taps}: get's values for the spinning picture, and the taps so far.
